subject: CipherCore — post-demo budget & discount options
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Park <jane@ciphercore.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: token profile, budget range & early discount options

Hi Jane — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we can lock pricing/options with your finance team: 

Summary of call:
- Primary workload: interactive customer support + nightly batch indexing for embeddings. ~70% gen, 30% embeddings.
- Typical sequence length: 200–400 tokens for gen, embeddings ~512 tokens.
- Target latency: P95 < 500ms for interactive flows.
- Current monthly usage today (prototype): ~120k gen tokens, 250k embeddings. Expected growth with beta release: 1.2M–4M gen tokens / month in months 1–6.

High-level pricing needs you mentioned:
- Target unit economics: $X / 1M tokens range (you asked us to come back with concrete $/1M).
- You are evaluating startup program eligibility and interested in a committed-use discount if you can give a 6–12 month minimum.

What I need from you to finalize proposals:
1) A 6–12 month expected monthly token band (low/likely/high). A quick spreadsheet would be ideal — I attached a template.
2) Confirmation whether legal needs a draft SOW/DocuSign now or can wait until we agree commercial terms.

Preliminary options we can offer (internal pricing guideline; final numbers after projection):
- Startup package: 50% off hosted list for first 3 months + one-time $5k founder credit (conditional on verification).
- Committed 6mo: tiered unit pricing starting at $850 / 1M gen tokens at 1–5M/mo, with incremental volume breaks and reserved capacity options for latency SLAs.
- Multi-year (12mo+): blended deeper discounts and guaranteed capacity reservation; we can model a 10–20% additional rebate depending on commit size.

Next step suggestion: if you can share the projection by EOD Thu we’ll model three scenarios (starter, scale, reserved) and present a short commercialization sheet for your CFO. Aditya (cc) — can you weigh in on founder credit/approval flow? Marissa — I’ll need a quick billing-run to prepare a preliminary quote.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Jane Park <jane@ciphercore.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom@ciphercore.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token profile, budget range & early discount options

Thanks Mina — helpful recap. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Budget guardrails: for Q2 we have a hard limit of $20k mo for infra; if the pricing you model gets us under $1,000 / 1M tokens we can consider a 6mo commit tied to usage floors. For BAU scale (post-product-market fit) we expect 5–8M gen tokens / month and would need a path to < $600 / 1M to ramp affordably.

2) Startup verification: we are YC S20 but Census says we qualify; can you confirm the verification doc list?

3) Timeline: Legal prefers getting a draft SOW in parallel with commercial terms so procurement can start review. If you can push a DocuSign draft by next Tue that would be ideal.

I’ll attach a quick internal projection and a consolidated low/likely/high band by EOD Thu.

Quick Q — is the founder credit applied to invoices or as account credit in the console?

—Jane
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Park <jane@ciphercore.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token profile, budget range & early discount options

Jane — thanks, appreciate the bands and the YC note. Attached is our projection template (ciphercore_usage_projection_v2.xlsx) and the current startup terms (redwood_startup_terms.pdf) which lists required verification (company domain, incorporation docs, YC batch). Founder credit is issued as account credit that applies to invoices in the billing console (so it reduces amounts due on future invoices).

Below are three modeled scenarios based on your rough bands (we’ll refine when we get your sheet):

1) Starter (0.5–1M gen tokens/mo): 
- Unit: $1,200 / 1M gen tokens (hosted list)
- Startup program applied: 50% off for first 3 months -> effective $600 / 1M for months 1–3
- Founder credit: one-time $5,000 account credit
- No SLA reserved capacity

2) Committed 6mo (1–5M gen tokens/mo):
- Unit: $850 / 1M gen tokens with a 6-month commit at the 1M floor (ramp true-ups monthly).
- If actual > committed band, overage billed at committed rate until 120% of band, then standard overage pricing.
- Option to add reserved nodes (+15%) for latency SLOs.

3) Growth reserve (5–8M gen tokens/mo; 12mo):
- Blended unit: $510–$600 / 1M (depending on exact commit & ability to allow model-variant fallback).
- Includes 10% rebate applied at renewal if spend thresholds met.

Notes/assumptions: these are modeled for gen tokens only; embeddings priced separately at $X / 1M embeddings (I’ll put exact number in the sheet). All numbers exclude applicable taxes.

Next steps I can take now: 
- Aditya: can you confirm whether the $5k founder credit and a 50% first-3-month startup promo are ok to extend to CipherCore pending verification? (quick yes/no would be great).
- Marissa: please prepare a draft quote template (line items + provisional DocuSign SOW stub) so we can share with CipherCore legal next Tue.

If we get the projection by tonight I’ll send the modeled quote and attach a DocuSign draft by Monday EOD.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token profile, budget range & early discount options

Quick note — Mina, you’re green to offer the 50% startup promo for 3 months plus the one-time $5k founder credit pending verification. Confirm the verification items in the attached terms are met (YC docs and incorporation). Also approve the provisional committed prices below for the quote:
- Starter promo numbers as listed.
- Committed 6mo: $850 / 1M gen tokens at 1M floor.
- 12mo reserved: target $560 / 1M at 5M+ band with 10% renewal rebate.

Marissa — please draft the quote and SOW stub. When Mina sends the projection, we’ll lock the invoice schedule and send a DocuSign link.

Aditya
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
